svg.title: Reports over time: open work, flow and cycle time by week, from history — SoftTrack web design mockup (#329)
svg.desc: A report over time adds a range and an interval to the builder. It counts what was open at the end of each interval, what was created, resolved or reopened in it, or cycle and lead time, grouped by anything history holds, the team’s fields included. It begins where each field’s history begins, and every point opens the tickets it counted.

svg.text: Done when creating a ticket records an opening event for each of its field values and the migration writes one per existing value; when a report over time counts open work, flow,
and cycle and lead time per day, week or month, grouped by status category, priority, assignee, sprint, epic or a team field; when it begins where the history begins and says so;
when labels are not offered; and when a year of a busy team stays inside a tested time budget.
